text.p: Argentina Tuesday placed 250 million pesos in 91-day Letes Treasury bills at a discount strike rate of 6.10 percent and $250 million in 182-day bills at 6.09 percent, the Economy Ministry said.
The price at the strike rate on the 91-day bills was 984.581 and the price on the 182-day bills was 969.212.
There were 100 bids on the 91-day bills for a bid-to-cover ratio of 5.33 times and 108 bids on the 182-day bills for a bid-to-cover ratio of 8.65 times.

The discount rate of 6.10 percent on the 91-day bills was lower than expected by analysts. In a Reuters poll, traders anticipated a rate of 6.50 percent. Likewise for the 182-day bills, players were anticipating a rate around 6.50 percent.
Market makers will be offered up to 10 percent more of both issues until 1730 local/2030 GMT Tuesday.
For more information see ARG04 and ARG05.
